title: Acquiring William Corliss's Sourcebook Project papers

plain: The papers of William Corliss, an American writer who spent years on a series of books called the Sourcebook Project, a catalogue of strange and unexplained reports, were taken from the United States to Sweden. Clas Svahn, a Swedish UFO researcher who says he acquired them himself, tells the story to Jesse Michels. The archive is part of why Svahn is said to hold so much UFO evidence.
